question.problem:
Let $R=[-3,1]\times [2,4]$ be a region in the $xy$-plane, and let $f(x,y)$ be a function defined over $R.$
The lower and upper Riemann sums corresponding to an arbitrary partition $P$ of $R$ are given by

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}-{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}, \\ U(f,P) & ={\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j}-{x}_{i-1})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Using the definition of the double integral in terms of $L(f,P)$ and $U(f,P),$ compute ${∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A.$

*Hint: You may wish to make use of the following result:*

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}=({x}_{m}^{2}-{x}_{0}^{2})({y}_{n}-{y}_{0})\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
For a function $f(x,y),$ the double integral of $f$ over a rectangular region $R$ is the unique number $I$ (if it exists) such that

$$
L(f,P)\le I\le U(f,P)
$$

over all partitions $P$ of $R.$

First, notice that ${\overset{¯}{x}}_{i}=\frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})$ will always lie between ${x}_{i-1}$ and ${x}_{i}$, and similarly ${\overset{¯}{y}}_{j}=\frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})$ will always lie between ${y}_{j-1}$ and ${y}_{j}.$ Therefore,

$$
{y}_{j-1}-{x}_{i}\le \frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})-\frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})\le {y}_{j}-{x}_{i-1}.
$$

Multiplying this by $Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}$ and applying the double summation gives:

$$
L(f,P)\le {\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}[\frac{1}{2}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})-\frac{1}{2}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})]Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}\le U(f,P)
$$

Separating the sums using the addition rule, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P) & \le \frac{1}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j}-\frac{1}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{i-1}+{x}_{i})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} \\  & \le U(f,P).\end{aligned}
$$

Using the hint, we get the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{1}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({x}_{j-1}+{x}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =\frac{1}{2}({1}^{2}-(-3)^{2})(4-2)=-8 \\ \frac{1}{2}{\sum }_{i=1}^{m}{\sum }_{j=1}^{n}({y}_{j-1}+{y}_{j})Δ{x}_{i}Δ{y}_{j} & =\frac{1}{2}({4}^{2}-{2}^{2})(1-(-3))=24\end{aligned}
$$

Finally then:

$$
\begin{aligned}L(f,P)\le 24-(-8)\le U(f,P)\,⟹\,L(f,P)\le 32\le U(f,P)\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that 

$$
{∬}_{R}f(x,y)\,\text{d}A=32.
$$
